column1: # Every pinned install source. One row per artifact; a name may have several rows.
# name     selection name (core rows install on every run)
# groups   core, internal (installed only as a dependency), or a comma list of: languages, lsp, tools
# version  pinned version; scripts/pin replaces it in the URL when updating. npm rows may say latest,
#          which installs the newest release on every run.
# platform linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, darwin-arm64, any, or a system backend (apt, dnf, pacman, brew)
# source   https URL (archive or bare binary), npm:PACKAGE, go:MODULE, git:URL (version is a commit),
# bins     comma list of executables this row provides; download rows link them into tools/bin
# Download rows win over system rows. System rows are skipped when their bins already exist.
# Instructions, skills, Pi extensions, and Claude mods for the pi and claude selections.
